name: Neon Terminal
tagline: Typed commands, green phosphor glow, a glitch cut to the logo.
description: Developer-tool launch style. A terminal window types a real command, output lines pop in with check marks, then a glitch transition reveals the product name with a glowing install chip.

rhythm.notes: Output lines every 0.3–0.4s, like a real CLI. Hold the final URL line ~1s before the glitch.

guide:
- Use real commands and believable output (timings, counts, URLs). Never lorem ipsum.
- Type commands with a width tween and ease steps(<characters>), ~22 chars per second. Keep the block cursor blinking (0.01s opacity yoyo, 0.25s repeatDelay).
- Output: muted (#4f7a5d) for progress, green check marks (#3dff8f) for success, yellow ▲ for highlights.
- Keep the scanline overlay (repeating 2px lines, 22% black) above everything.
- Transition out with 3–4 quick skewX jitters (0.05s) then fade; reveal the product name by squeezing scaleX from 1.6 to 1 with expo.out (animate transforms, not letter-spacing).
- End on a pill-shaped install command chip in the primary green.
